summary: fix(pinterest): auth login omits msot:write by default; add --scopes/PINTEREST_SCOPES and a basic preset.
reason: Pinterest rejects msot:write (not in its documented OAuth scopes) with 'invalid scopes requested', failing login for apps without MSOT access. The generator emits every spec scope unconditionally.
validated_outcome: TestPinterestLoginScopes: default scope string omits msot:write; --scopes overrides.
